description: Hey. We're currently a small team of High School students just spending spare moments to work on NASA SAC.
summary: This project explores Nasa's abandoned equipments via an online visual novel-like approach. This project aims to teach what happens to equipments that nasa left on the Moon and Mars with visual images and text explanations.
details: This project aims to teach young adults or children about Nasa's discarded equipments on the moon and mars using colorful texts and images. The languages used are HTML, CSS, and JS. Some AI assistance were used, such as Gemini 4 Hydrogen and GPT-6 Luna for debugging and complex math. Unfortunately, due to real-life occupations, this project was unable to be finished in-time as we try our best to not use AI as much as we can.
